items.title: German Startup’s Rocket Deploys Satellites in a First for Europe
items.author: Paula Doenecke
items.content: <article>An Isar Aerospace rocket blasted off from a launchpad in Norway and delivered a payload of satellites into orbit, marking a key step in Europe’s efforts to compete with US companies for commercial space missions.</article>

items.title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
items.content: <article>Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: TCS Plans One-Gigawatt Capacity Data Center in Southern India
items.author: Ashutosh Joshi
items.content: <article>Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.</article>

items.title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Climb 52% With AI Server Momentum
items.author: Debby Wu
items.content: <article>Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 52% rise in monthly sales, lifted by demand for servers in a global race to build data centers and AI computational capacity.</article>

items.title: Jump Trading Expands Office Space in Hong Kong’s IFC Building
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>Jump Trading is adding office space in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, the latest sign of global trading firms expanding their presence in the city.</article>

items.title: Japan Says Progress Made on $550 Billion Investment Pact With US
items.author: Yoshiaki Nohara
items.content: <article>Japanese Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa said progress was being made on a $550 billion investment initiative set up as part of a trade deal with the US last year.</article>

items.title: China’s 26% Earnings Boom Lands With a Thud in the Stock Market
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.</article>

items.title: Carney’s Push to Build Canadian Data Centers is Running Into Backlash
items.author: Nojoud Al Mallees
items.content: <article>The data center backlash that has gripped US politics is spreading north, complicating Prime Minister Mark Carney’s efforts to attract investment in the rapidly expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure.</article>

items.title: Abu Dhabi’s G42 Weighs US Ownership to Safeguard AI Chip Access
items.author: Alex Dooler, Zainab Fattah and Dinesh Nair
items.content: <article>Executives at Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence firm G42 have held exploratory talks over potentially selling a majority stake to American companies, people familiar with the matter said, as it races to guarantee access to high-tech chips beyond next year.</article>
